text_block_list.text:
And so, the first three years spent with 
TM Opera O came to an eventful and 
dramatic close.

"A respectable record and an even greater 
impact. However, that was hardly enough to 
tame the 'Overlord of the Century's 
End'..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what a tragedy! Why must we disagree 
so completely?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ha! I see! So that's it. It's because I 
have become the "End-of-Century 
Overlord"...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"So in the end, you are incapable of 
grasping the grand, farsighted designs of 
one who lives forever, hmm?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Trainer-kun, lend an ear! In 
recognition of my recent 
accomplishmentsâ

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A special race bearing my very own name 
has been arranged to be held!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Its name is none other than the "T.M. 
Opera O Memorial"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What do you think of this clever title? 
The theme of "me" secretly breathes within 
the countermelody, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

It's a rather straightforward name, but... 
something worth celebrating all the same.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However! The URA and I couldn't agree on 
what kind of race it should actually be, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Unlike you, they don't understand my true 
essence at all. To propose a race plan 
like that...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's just completely ordinary stuff.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will give a one-hour speech before the 
race, and the winner will forcibly be 
mailed a life-sized trophy of me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is as far as you can make me concede. 
Calling something like this a 
'memorial'... isn't that utterly 
laughable?

They seem to be giving it plenty of 
consideration, but... even that doesn't 
seem to satisfy her.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I really think we should just give in to 
all the "Overlord of the Century's End"'s 
demands here.
choice_data_list: What kind of race is it?
What kind of race is it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, that is...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At the newly established T.M. Opera O 
Racecourse! Held right there is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Host: me! Opening remarks: me! Guest of 
honor: me! Competitor: me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the winner! I'm the loser too! I'm the 
presenter, and I'm the one receiving it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It was flawless, painted in my colors from 
start to finish!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now this is truly worthy of the T.M. Opera 
O Memorial! Ha-ha-ha-ha!
choice_data_list: Is that even a race anymore?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, come to think of it, you're right. 
But...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
One shouldn't dwell on trifles. As long as 
the majesty of the "Overlord of the 
Century's End" spreads and I remain 
beautiful, that is all that matters.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go negotiate one more 
time. Trainer, you're coming with me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Show me what the end-of-the-century 
Trainer's negotiating skills can do.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

I'm grabbed by the scruff of my neck and 
hauled away. Same absurd demands, same 
tyrannical attitude.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

And echoing through the negotiation room 
—a refined burst of laughter. However...

Far from merely causing a stir, T.M. Opera 
O always entertained everyone with her 
wildly eccentric antics.

Indeed! This is the T.M. Opera O Theater! 
An opera of laughter and surprises that 
shall never come to an end!
